name: Birdwatcher Morven

intro.text: There's an osprey that fishes here. It dives from thirty metres, feet first. I've been trying to photograph it for three summers. I have 400 photos of the sky.

win: Hm. You moved. I'd have liked to see the dive.
after: Ospreys come back from West Africa every spring to the same nest. Think about that next time you complain about the A82.
